subject: math
cluster: Develop understanding of fractions as numbers

items.prompt:
One of $4$ equal pieces is
A) $\frac{1}{4}$
B) $\frac{4}{1}$
C) $\frac{1}{2}$
D) $4$

In $\frac{3}{5}$, the $5$ tells
A) parts taken
B) the number of equal parts
C) the whole
D) nothing
items.answer: B) the number of equal parts

items.prompt:
One of $6$ equal parts is
A) $\frac{1}{6}$
B) $\frac{6}{1}$
C) $\frac{1}{3}$
D) $6$

$\frac{2}{3}$ means
A) $2$ of $3$ equal parts
B) $3$ of $2$ parts
C) $2 + 3$
D) $23$

In $\frac{3}{8}$, the $3$ tells
A) the number of parts taken
B) the number of equal parts
C) the whole
D) nothing
items.answer: A) the number of parts taken

items.prompt:
One of $2$ equal parts is
A) $\frac{1}{2}$
B) $2$
C) $\frac{2}{1}$
D) $\frac{1}{4}$

A whole split into $5$ equal parts: each part is
A) $\frac{1}{5}$
B) $5$
C) $\frac{5}{1}$
D) $\frac{1}{4}$

$\frac{4}{9}$: the numerator and denominator are
A) $4$ and $9$
B) $9$ and $4$
C) both $4$
D) both $9$
